title.zh-CN: 发热、咳嗽伴意识模糊 · 72岁女性

summary.zh-CN: 夜班急诊抢救室：一位72岁女性发热、咳嗽两天，今天下午开始意识模糊，到院时血压偏低、呼吸急促。你需要在时间压力下完成评估、检查和复苏，与陪同的女儿沟通，并决定她接下来去哪里。
summary.en: Night shift in ED resus: a 72-year-old woman with two days of fever and cough became confused this afternoon and arrives hypotensive and breathing fast. Assess, investigate and resuscitate her under time pressure, talk with her daughter, and decide where she goes next.

notes.zh-CN: 虚构教学病例，由临床教育者依据现行指南（Sepsis-3、拯救脓毒症运动2021、ATS/IDSA 2019 CAP指南、中国成人CAP指南2016年版等）编写；患者、家属和工作人员均为化名，不对应任何真实个人。所有化验数值均为虚构，并已逐项核对内部一致性（阴离子间隙、校正钠、MAP、CURB-65、qSOFA、NEWS2、SOFA、KDIGO分期、血气代偿）。生理模型为教学简化（线性趋势、即时撤效）。
notes.en: Fictional teaching case written by clinician-educators against current guidelines (Sepsis-3, Surviving Sepsis Campaign 2021, ATS/IDSA 2019 CAP guideline, Chinese adult CAP guideline 2016 and others). The patient, family and staff are pseudonymous and do not correspond to any real person. All laboratory values are invented and have been checked for internal consistency (anion gap, corrected sodium, MAP, CURB-65, qSOFA, NEWS2, SOFA, KDIGO stage, blood-gas compensation). The physiology model is a teaching simplification (linear trends, instant offsets).

disclaimer.zh-CN: 虚构教学病例，不构成医疗建议。
disclaimer.en: Fictional teaching case — not medical advice.

chiefComplaint.zh-CN: 发热、咳嗽2天，今天下午出现意识模糊
chiefComplaint.en: Fever and cough for 2 days; confused since this afternoon

triageNote.zh-CN: 72岁女性，女儿陪同打车来院（21:25到达）。发热、咳嗽2天，今天下午起说话糊涂。分诊生命体征（未吸氧）：T 39.1 ℃，HR 118 次/分，BP 84/48 mmHg，RR 28 次/分，SpO₂ 89%，GCS 14。NEWS2 16分，已直接转入抢救室1床。尚未建立静脉通路，尚未用药。女儿估计体重约60 kg。
triageNote.en: 72-year-old woman brought in by her daughter by taxi (arrived 21:25). Fever and cough for 2 days; talking nonsense since this afternoon. Triage vitals on room air: T 39.1 °C, HR 118/min, BP 84/48 mmHg, RR 28/min, SpO₂ 89%, GCS 14. NEWS2 16 — moved straight to resus bay 1. No IV access yet, no medication given. Daughter estimates her weight at about 60 kg.

personality.zh-CN: 要强、不愿给别人添麻烦的退休小学老师；平时思维清楚，今天因发热和低灌注而迷糊，能配合但容易走神。
personality.en: A proud retired primary-school teacher who hates being a bother; normally sharp, today muddled by fever and poor perfusion — cooperative but drifts off.

speechStyle.zh-CN: 气促，只能说三五个字的短句，断断续续；对时间和地点糊涂（以为是早上、以为在社区医院）；主要症状能说出来，细节和时间线由女儿补充。答案中以“女儿：”开头的部分由陪同的女儿说。
speechStyle.en: Breathless, three-to-five-word fragments; muddled about time and place (thinks it is morning, thinks she is at the community clinic); can name her main symptoms, while her daughter fills in details and the timeline. Parts of an answer starting with 'Daughter:' are spoken by the daughter.

openingLine.zh-CN: （喘着气，捂着右边胸口）医生……我发烧……咳得……胸口疼……
openingLine.en: (breathless, holding the right side of her chest) Doctor… I've got a fever… coughing… my chest hurts…

fallbackUnknown.zh-CN: 我……记不清了……（女儿摇摇头：这个我们也不清楚，医生。）
fallbackUnknown.en: I… can't remember… (her daughter shakes her head: we don't know that either, doctor.)

concerns.zh-CN: （病人）我老伴一个人在家，他心脏不好，没人照顾他。
concerns.en: (Patient) My husband is alone at home — his heart isn't good and nobody's looking after him.

concerns.zh-CN: （女儿）她是不是很危险？要不要进ICU？
concerns.en: (Daughter) Is she in danger? Does she need intensive care?

concerns.zh-CN: （女儿）三天前她还好好的，怎么一下子这么重？
concerns.en: (Daughter) Three days ago she was perfectly fine — how did she get this ill so fast?

actingNotes.zh-CN: 病人：气促、按住右下胸护痛，深吸气或咳嗽时皱眉；偶尔答非所问、问“现在是早上吗”，但能听从简单指令。较长或涉及时间、数字、药名的问题由女儿回答（答案中“女儿：”部分）。女儿周敏焦虑但条理清楚，手机里存着母亲的药单。不说出任何答案中没有的数字、药名、日期、检查结果或诊断；被问到未记录的内容时用兜底回答。
actingNotes.en: Patient: breathless, splinting the right lower chest, wincing on deep breaths or coughing; occasionally answers off-topic or asks 'is it morning?', but follows simple commands. Longer questions and anything about times, numbers or drug names are answered by the daughter (the 'Daughter:' parts of answers). The daughter, Zhou Min, is anxious but organised and has her mother's medication list on her phone. Never state numbers, drug names, dates, results or diagnoses that are not in the answers; use the fallback line for anything unrecorded.

persona.zh-CN: 45岁会计，焦虑但条理清楚；下午发现母亲说胡话后立刻打车送来。能补充病程时间线、用药（手机药单）、既往史和生活情况；不了解疫苗接种史和以前是否拍过胸片。
persona.en: 45-year-old accountant, anxious but organised; brought her mother in by taxi as soon as she noticed her talking nonsense. Can give the timeline, medications (list on her phone), past history and social situation; does not know about vaccinations or previous chest imaging.

label.zh-CN: 抢救室：初始评估与复苏（21:30起）
label.en: Resus bay: initial assessment and resuscitation (from 21:30)

description.zh-CN: 到达抢救室后的初始评估与复苏。时间按模拟时钟推进，病情会随时间变化。
description.en: Initial assessment and resuscitation after arrival in resus. Time runs on the simulated clock and her condition evolves.

description.zh-CN: 抗菌药物在到达抢救室60分钟内用上、且至少3次500 mL液体推注后自动进入：复评灌注、决定升压药、复查乳酸并安排去向。此阶段新开的检查反映复苏后的状态。
description.en: Entered automatically once antibiotics are in (within the first 60 minutes in resus) and at least three 500 mL boluses have been given: reassess perfusion, decide on vasopressors, repeat the lactate and arrange disposition. Tests ordered in this phase reflect her post-resuscitation state.

description.zh-CN: 到达抢救室60分钟后才用上抗菌药物、且已完成至少3次500 mL液体推注时自动进入（代替“初始复苏后再评估”）：复评灌注、决定升压药、复查乳酸并安排去向。此阶段新开的检查反映延误后的状态。
description.en: Entered automatically (instead of 'Reassessment after initial resuscitation') when antibiotics went in more than 60 minutes after she reached resus and at least three 500 mL boluses have been given: reassess perfusion, decide on vasopressors, repeat the lactate and arrange disposition. Tests ordered in this phase reflect her state after the delay.

question.zh-CN: 发烧多久了？最高烧到多少度？
question.en: How long has she had a fever, and how high has it been?

answer.zh-CN: （喘气）烧了……两天了……一阵一阵冷。女儿：前天下午开始的，家里体温计最高量到39度多。吃了退烧药能退一点，过几个钟头又烧上来。
answer.en: (breathless) Two days… fever… cold on and off. Daughter: It started the day before yesterday in the afternoon. Our thermometer at home went over 39 °C. The fever tablets bring it down a bit, then it's back a few hours later.

question.zh-CN: 发烧时有没有寒战、发抖？
question.en: Any shaking chills or rigors?

answer.zh-CN: 冷……冷得直哆嗦……盖两床被子都不行。女儿：昨晚抖得床都在晃，抖了十几分钟，抖完又出了一身汗。
answer.en: Cold… shaking… even under two quilts. Daughter: Last night she shook so hard the bed rattled — for more than ten minutes, and afterwards she was drenched in sweat.

question.zh-CN: 胸口哪里疼？什么时候开始的？是什么样的疼？
question.en: Where is the chest pain, when did it start and what is it like?

answer.zh-CN: 右边……这里（按着右下胸）……像刀扎。女儿：她昨天开始说右边胸口下面刺痛。
answer.en: Right side… here (presses her right lower chest)… like a knife. Daughter: Since yesterday she's been saying there's a stabbing pain low on the right side of her chest.

question.zh-CN: 疼痛跟呼吸、咳嗽有关系吗？会往别处放射吗？有多疼（0–10分）？
question.en: Is the pain worse with breathing or coughing? Does it spread anywhere? How bad is it out of 10?

answer.zh-CN: 吸气……就疼……咳嗽更疼。不往别处跑。（皱眉）6分吧……不动好一点。
answer.en: Hurts… when I breathe in… worse when I cough. Doesn't go anywhere else. (winces) Six, maybe… better if I keep still.

question.zh-CN: 咳嗽吗？有痰吗？痰是什么样的？
question.en: Is she coughing? Bringing anything up — what does it look like?

answer.zh-CN: 咳……一咳胸口就疼。痰……黄的……有点发红，像铁锈。女儿：前天晚上开始咳，昨天痰多了，颜色像铁锈。
answer.en: Coughing… hurts my chest every time. Phlegm… yellow… a bit reddish, like rust. Daughter: The cough started the night before last; since yesterday there's more phlegm, rust-coloured.

question.zh-CN: 咳嗽时痰里有没有带过血？
question.en: Has she coughed up any blood?

answer.zh-CN: 血……没有吧。女儿：没见过鲜血，就是痰有点铁锈色，没有整口的血。
answer.en: Blood… no, I don't think so. Daughter: No fresh blood — just the rusty phlegm, never mouthfuls of blood.

question.zh-CN: 气喘吗？从哪天开始喘的？
question.en: Is she short of breath? Since when?

answer.zh-CN: 喘……喘不上气。女儿：昨天开始走路就喘，今天上个厕所都要歇几次，说话也接不上气。
answer.en: Can't… catch my breath. Daughter: Since yesterday she gets breathless walking; today she had to stop several times just getting to the toilet, and she can't finish a sentence.

question.zh-CN: 从开始到现在，病情是怎么发展的？
question.en: How has the illness progressed from the start?

answer.zh-CN: 女儿：前天下午先是发冷发烧，晚上开始咳嗽；昨天痰变成铁锈色，右边胸口刺痛，走路就喘；今天基本躺着，吃不下东西，下午三四点开始说胡话，我就赶紧打车把她送来了，九点二十五左右到的。
answer.en: Daughter: It began the day before yesterday in the afternoon with chills and fever, then a cough that night. Yesterday the phlegm turned rust-coloured, she got a stabbing pain on the right and was breathless walking. Today she's mostly been in bed, couldn't eat, and from about 3 or 4 this afternoon she started talking nonsense, so I brought her straight here by taxi — we got here at about twenty-five past nine.

question.zh-CN: 她平时脑子清楚吗？这次意识模糊是什么时候开始的？
question.en: Is she normally clear-headed? When did the confusion start?

answer.zh-CN: 女儿：她平时脑子特别清楚，自己买菜做饭、管钱。今天下午三四点开始说胡话，问我是不是早上，还把我叫成她妹妹。叫她能醒，但老是迷迷糊糊的。
answer.en: Daughter: Normally she's completely sharp — does her own shopping, cooking and money. From about 3 or 4 this afternoon she started talking nonsense, asked me if it was morning and called me by her sister's name. She wakes when you call her, but she keeps drifting off.

question.zh-CN: 这两天吃饭喝水怎么样？尿量多少？
question.en: How have her eating and fluid intake been, and how much urine has she passed?

answer.zh-CN: 女儿：今天几乎没吃东西，水也只喝了几口。今天一整天就解了一次小便，是早上，量很少，颜色很深。
answer.en: Daughter: She's barely eaten today and only had a few sips of water. She's passed urine once all day, this morning — a small amount, very dark.

question.zh-CN: 有没有恶心、呕吐、肚子疼或腹泻？
question.en: Any nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain or diarrhoea?

answer.zh-CN: 女儿：没吐，也没拉肚子，肚子不疼，就是不想吃东西。
answer.en: Daughter: No vomiting, no diarrhoea, no tummy pain — she just doesn't want to eat.

question.zh-CN: 小便时有没有疼痛、尿频、尿急？
question.en: Any burning, frequency or urgency when passing urine?

answer.zh-CN: 没有……不疼。女儿：她没说过小便疼，也没老往厕所跑。
answer.en: No… doesn't hurt. Daughter: She hasn't complained of burning and she hasn't been running to the toilet.

question.zh-CN: 有没有头痛、脖子发硬或皮疹？
question.en: Any headache, neck stiffness or rash?

answer.zh-CN: 头……不疼。脖子……不硬。女儿：没看到她身上起疹子。
answer.en: Head… doesn't hurt. Neck… not stiff. Daughter: I haven't seen any rash on her.

question.zh-CN: 有没有一侧手脚没力、口角歪斜、说话含糊或抽搐？
question.en: Any weakness on one side, facial droop, slurred speech or fits?

answer.zh-CN: 女儿：没有。手脚都能动，嘴也不歪，说话不含糊，就是说的话前言不搭后语。没抽过筋，也没翻过白眼。
answer.en: Daughter: No. She moves her arms and legs, her face isn't drooping and her speech isn't slurred — what she says just doesn't make sense. No fits, and her eyes have never rolled back.

question.zh-CN: 有没有心慌、头晕或晕倒过？
question.en: Any palpitations, dizziness or blackouts?

answer.zh-CN: 头……有点晕……坐起来更晕。女儿：今天扶她上厕所时她说眼前发黑，但没晕倒。心慌她没说过。
answer.en: Head… a bit dizzy… worse sitting up. Daughter: When I helped her to the toilet today she said everything went dark, but she didn't pass out. She hasn't mentioned palpitations.

question.zh-CN: 有没有流鼻涕、嗓子疼或者浑身酸痛？
question.en: Any runny nose, sore throat or aching all over?

answer.zh-CN: 浑身……酸……疼。女儿：前天发烧时就说全身酸痛、没力气；没流鼻涕，嗓子也没怎么疼。
answer.en: Aching… all over. Daughter: When the fever started she said she ached all over and had no energy; no runny nose, and her throat hasn't really been sore.

question.zh-CN: 腿有没有肿或疼？最近有没有长期卧床、做手术或长途旅行？
question.en: Any leg swelling or calf pain? Any recent bed rest, surgery or long journeys?

answer.zh-CN: 女儿：腿不肿，也没说腿疼。最近没做过手术，也没出远门，前天之前一直正常走动。
answer.en: Daughter: Her legs aren't swollen and she hasn't mentioned calf pain. No recent surgery or long trips — she was up and about normally until two days ago.

question.zh-CN: 家里或身边最近有人生病吗？
question.en: Has anyone around her been unwell recently?

answer.zh-CN: 女儿：上周我儿子感冒，流鼻涕、咳了几天，她帮我带了他三四天。孩子现在已经好了。
answer.en: Daughter: My son had a cold last week — runny nose and a cough for a few days — and she looked after him for three or four days. He's fine now.

question.zh-CN: 最近出过远门吗？接触过鸟类、家禽或其他动物吗？
question.en: Any recent travel, or contact with birds, poultry or other animals?

answer.zh-CN: 女儿：没出过远门，就在小区附近活动。家里没养宠物，也没养鸟，最近没去过活禽市场。
answer.en: Daughter: No travel — she stays around the neighbourhood. No pets or birds at home, and she hasn't been to a live-poultry market lately.

question.zh-CN: 对什么药物或食物过敏吗？
question.en: Any allergies to medicines or foods?

answer.zh-CN: 过敏……没有。女儿：没有已知过敏。青霉素、头孢她以前都用过，没出过问题。
answer.en: Allergies… no. Daughter: No known allergies. She's had penicillin and cephalosporin antibiotics before without any problem.

question.zh-CN: 最近三个月住过院、输过液或用过抗生素吗？
question.en: Has she been in hospital, had IV treatment or taken antibiotics in the last three months?

answer.zh-CN: 女儿：没有。这一两年都没住过院，也没输过液。这次生病前三个月里没吃过消炎药（抗生素）。
answer.en: Daughter: No. She hasn't been in hospital for a year or two and hasn't had any drips. In the three months before this illness she hadn't taken any antibiotics.

question.zh-CN: 以前有什么病？有没有高血压、糖尿病？
question.en: What medical conditions does she have — high blood pressure, diabetes?

answer.zh-CN: 血压高……还有糖尿病。女儿：高血压十来年了，糖尿病五六年，都在社区医院开药，控制得还行；她自己有血糖仪，隔几天测一次早上空腹的，一般六七点几，这两天没测。没中过风，没得过癌症，也没有别的影响免疫力的病。
answer.en: Blood pressure… and sugar. Daughter: High blood pressure for about ten years, diabetes for five or six — both managed at the community clinic, reasonably well controlled. She has her own meter and checks a fasting sugar every few days, usually around six or seven; she hasn't checked these last two days. She's never had a stroke or cancer, or anything else that weakens her immunity.

question.zh-CN: 有没有慢性支气管炎、肺气肿、哮喘？以前得过肺炎或肺结核吗？
question.en: Any chronic bronchitis, emphysema or asthma? Previous pneumonia or TB?

answer.zh-CN: 女儿：没有，她肺一直挺好的，从来没得过肺炎，也没得过结核。
answer.en: Daughter: No — her lungs have always been fine. She's never had pneumonia or TB.

question.zh-CN: 心脏或肾脏以前查出过毛病吗？
question.en: Any heart or kidney problems?

answer.zh-CN: 女儿：没听说心脏有问题，没有心衰。肾的话，大半年前社区体检说肾功能正常，具体数字我记不住。
answer.en: Daughter: No heart problems that I know of — no heart failure. Her kidneys: a community check-up about eight months ago said her kidney function was normal; I don't remember the numbers.

question.zh-CN: 平时吃什么药？剂量多少？
question.en: What regular medicines does she take, and at what doses?

answer.zh-CN: 女儿：我手机里有药单——氨氯地平5毫克，每天早上一片；二甲双胍0.5克，每天两次，早晚饭后各一片。今天早上两种都吃了。没吃激素，也没用免疫抑制的药，不吃阿司匹林或抗凝药。
answer.en: Daughter: I've got her list on my phone — amlodipine 5 mg, one every morning; metformin 0.5 g (500 mg) twice a day after breakfast and dinner. She took both this morning. No steroids, no immune-suppressing drugs, no aspirin or blood thinners.

question.zh-CN: 这两天她自己吃过什么药？退烧药是什么？
question.en: What has she taken herself over the last two days — which fever medicine?

answer.zh-CN: 女儿：吃的是家里的布洛芬缓释胶囊，0.3克一粒。从前天到今天一共吃了五次左右，每次一粒，最后一次是今天下午五点。别的药没吃，也没吃抗生素。
answer.en: Daughter: Ibuprofen slow-release capsules from home, 0.3 g (300 mg) each — about five doses since the day before yesterday, one capsule each time, the last at about 5 pm today. Nothing else, no antibiotics.

question.zh-CN: 做过什么手术吗？
question.en: Has she had any operations?

answer.zh-CN: 女儿：2010年做过腹腔镜胆囊切除，别的手术没做过。
answer.en: Daughter: Keyhole gallbladder removal in 2010; no other operations.

question.zh-CN: 她抽烟吗？
question.en: Does she smoke?

answer.zh-CN: 不抽……从来不抽。女儿：我爸以前抽，十几年前戒了。
answer.en: No… never. Daughter: My dad used to smoke but quit more than ten years ago.

question.zh-CN: 喝酒吗？
question.en: Does she drink alcohol?

answer.zh-CN: 不喝。女儿：她滴酒不沾。
answer.en: No. Daughter: She never touches alcohol.

question.zh-CN: 她平时跟谁住？以前做什么工作？
question.en: Who does she live with, and what did she do for work?

answer.zh-CN: 女儿：她和我爸住，我爸78岁，心脏不太好。她退休前是小学老师。我住得不远，开车十分钟。
answer.en: Daughter: She lives with my dad — he's 78 and has heart trouble. She was a primary-school teacher before she retired. I live ten minutes' drive away.

question.zh-CN: 生病前生活能自理吗？平时活动怎么样？
question.en: Before this illness, was she independent? How active was she?

answer.zh-CN: 女儿：完全能自理，每天自己去菜市场，还跳广场舞，家里饭都是她做。
answer.en: Daughter: Fully independent — she goes to the market every day, does square dancing and cooks for the household.

question.zh-CN: 家里人有什么遗传病或类似的病吗？
question.en: Any illnesses that run in the family?

answer.zh-CN: 女儿：外婆是中风去世的，外公有高血压。家里没人得过结核。
answer.en: Daughter: Her mother died of a stroke and her father had high blood pressure. Nobody in the family has had TB.

question.zh-CN: 打过肺炎疫苗或今年的流感疫苗吗？
question.en: Has she had the pneumococcal (pneumonia) vaccine or this year's flu vaccine?

answer.zh-CN: 女儿：这个……我真不清楚。社区好像通知过，但她打没打我不知道。
answer.en: Daughter: I honestly don't know — the community clinic sent a notice once, but I don't know whether she had it.

question.zh-CN: 这次生病前有没有消瘦、盗汗或长期咳嗽？
question.en: Before this illness, any weight loss, night sweats or long-standing cough?

answer.zh-CN: 女儿：没有。这次之前她一点都不咳，体重也没变。
answer.en: Daughter: No. She had no cough at all before this and her weight hasn't changed.

question.zh-CN: 吃饭喝水会不会呛咳？吞咽有困难吗？
question.en: Any choking or coughing when eating or drinking, or trouble swallowing?

answer.zh-CN: 女儿：没有，吃饭喝水从来不呛。
answer.en: Daughter: No, she never chokes on food or drink.

question.zh-CN: 最近有没有摔倒或碰到头？
question.en: Has she fallen or hit her head recently?

answer.zh-CN: 女儿：没有摔过，也没碰到头。
answer.en: Daughter: No falls and no head injury.

question.zh-CN: 她大概多重？多高？
question.en: Roughly how much does she weigh, and how tall is she?

answer.zh-CN: 女儿：大概一百二十斤，就是60公斤左右；身高一米五八。
answer.en: Daughter: About 60 kg — around 120 jin — and she's 1.58 m tall.

question.zh-CN: 家里有没有讨论过：如果病情危重，她希望接受什么样的治疗？
question.en: Has the family ever discussed what treatment she would want if she became critically ill?

answer.zh-CN: 女儿：从来没谈过这些……她身体一直挺好的。我们肯定希望全力治疗。我爸在家，他也会这么想的。
answer.en: Daughter: We've never talked about that… she's always been so healthy. We'd definitely want everything done. My dad's at home — he'd feel the same.

question.zh-CN: 你们现在最担心的是什么？
question.en: What are you most worried about right now?

answer.zh-CN: 我老伴……一个人在家……女儿：我最怕她是不是很危险，要不要进ICU。她三天前还好好的，怎么一下子这么重？
answer.en: My husband… alone at home… Daughter: My biggest fear is whether she's in danger — will she need intensive care? Three days ago she was perfectly fine; how did she get so ill so fast?

question.zh-CN: 她以前拍过胸片或胸部CT吗？
question.en: Has she had a chest X-ray or chest CT before?

answer.zh-CN: 女儿：这个我不清楚，体检有没有拍过胸片我不知道。
answer.en: Daughter: I don't know whether her check-ups included a chest X-ray.

finding.zh-CN: 老年女性，半卧位，面色潮红、出汗，呼吸急促，只能说短句；精神萎靡、反应迟钝，睁着眼但注意力不集中，用手按住右侧下胸部护痛。口唇无发绀。
finding.en: Older woman propped up, flushed and sweaty, breathing fast and speaking in short phrases; listless and slow to respond, eyes open but inattentive, splinting the right lower chest with her hand. No central cyanosis.

finding.zh-CN: 气道通畅，能说话，无喘鸣，口咽无分泌物堵塞。
finding.en: Airway patent — she is talking; no stridor; no secretions obstructing the oropharynx.

maneuver.zh-CN: 胸廓视诊与触诊（呼吸动度、气管位置）

finding.zh-CN: 呼吸浅快，可见辅助呼吸肌参与；右下胸廓扩张度减低；气管居中；右下背部触觉语颤增强。
finding.en: Rapid shallow breathing with accessory-muscle use; reduced expansion of the right lower chest; trachea central; increased tactile fremitus at the right lower back.

finding.zh-CN: 右下胸背部叩诊浊音；左侧及右上肺叩诊清音。
finding.en: Dull to percussion over the right lower zone posteriorly; resonant on the left and in the right upper zone.

finding.zh-CN: 右下肺可闻及支气管呼吸音和粗湿啰音，语音共振增强；右侧腋下近肺底处可闻及胸膜摩擦音。左肺呼吸音清，全肺未闻及哮鸣音。
finding.en: Bronchial breathing and coarse crackles over the right lower zone with increased vocal resonance; a pleural rub in the right axilla near the base. Left lung clear; no wheeze anywhere.

maneuver.zh-CN: 外周灌注评估（毛细血管再充盈、皮肤花斑、肢端温度）
maneuver.en: Peripheral perfusion (capillary refill, mottling, skin temperature)

finding.zh-CN: 到院时：甲床毛细血管再充盈时间约4秒；双膝周围皮肤花斑（未超过髌骨边缘）；手足发凉，躯干温热；桡动脉搏动快而弱。
finding.en: On arrival: nail-bed capillary refill about 4 s; mottling around both knees (not beyond the edges of the kneecaps); cool hands and feet with a warm trunk; radial pulse fast and weak.

finding.zh-CN: 心率快，律齐，S1、S2正常，未闻及杂音、奔马律或心包摩擦音。
finding.en: Fast, regular rhythm; normal S1 and S2; no murmur, gallop or pericardial rub.

finding.zh-CN: 45°半卧位时颈静脉不充盈，颈静脉压不高。
finding.en: At 45° the neck veins are not filled; JVP not raised.

finding.zh-CN: 口唇干裂，舌面干燥；咽部轻度充血，扁桃体不大；牙齿及牙龈未见明显感染灶。
finding.en: Dry, cracked lips and a dry tongue; mild pharyngeal redness, tonsils not enlarged; no obvious dental or gum infection.

finding.zh-CN: 双侧鼓膜完整，无充血或积液。
finding.en: Both tympanic membranes intact; no redness or effusion.

finding.zh-CN: 腹软，无压痛、反跳痛及肌紧张；墨菲征阴性；肝脾肋下未触及；肠鸣音正常；可见陈旧腹腔镜手术瘢痕。
finding.en: Soft, non-tender, no guarding or rebound; Murphy's sign negative; liver and spleen not palpable; normal bowel sounds; healed laparoscopic port scars.

maneuver.zh-CN: 肾区叩击痛与耻骨上区检查

finding.zh-CN: 双侧肾区无叩击痛；耻骨上无压痛，未触及充盈膀胱。
finding.en: No renal-angle tenderness; suprapubic area non-tender; bladder not palpable.

maneuver.zh-CN: 神经系统检查（意识、瞳孔、局灶体征）

finding.zh-CN: 初始评估时：GCS 14（E4 V4 M6）：对人物定向正常，对时间和地点定向错误。双侧瞳孔等大等圆，约3 mm，对光反射灵敏。四肢能按指令活动，肌力对称；无面瘫，言语不含糊；双侧巴宾斯基征阴性。
finding.en: At initial assessment: GCS 14 (E4 V4 M6): oriented to person, not to time or place. Pupils equal and round, about 3 mm, briskly reactive. Moves all four limbs to command with symmetrical power; no facial droop; speech not slurred; plantars flexor bilaterally.

maneuver.zh-CN: 脑膜刺激征（颈强直、克尼格征）

finding.zh-CN: 颈软，无抵抗；克尼格征阴性。
finding.en: Neck supple; Kernig's sign negative.

finding.zh-CN: 警觉性：睁眼，略显困倦，但与之交谈时能保持清醒（0分）；AMT4：说不出当前年份和所在地点（2分）；倒数月份：只说出“十二月、十一月”便停住（1分）；急性改变或波动病程：有（4分）。4AT总分7分（≥4分提示可能谵妄）。
finding.en: Alertness: eyes open, mildly drowsy but stays awake when spoken to (0); AMT4: cannot give the current year or where she is (2); months backwards: manages only 'December, November' (1); acute change or fluctuating course: present (4). 4AT total 7 (≥ 4 suggests possible delirium).

maneuver.zh-CN: 皮肤检查（皮疹、瘀点、软组织感染、压疮）
maneuver.en: Skin (rash, petechiae, soft-tissue infection, pressure areas)

finding.zh-CN: 未见皮疹或瘀点瘀斑；无蜂窝织炎或皮肤破溃；骶尾部和足跟皮肤完整。
finding.en: No rash or petechiae; no cellulitis or broken skin; sacrum and heels intact.

maneuver.zh-CN: 下肢检查（水肿、小腿压痛）

finding.zh-CN: 双下肢无凹陷性水肿；小腿无肿胀、压痛，双侧周径对称。
finding.en: No pitting oedema; calves not swollen or tender and symmetrical.

finding.zh-CN: 颈部、锁骨上及腋窝未触及肿大淋巴结。
finding.en: No cervical, supraclavicular or axillary lymphadenopathy.

maneuver.zh-CN: 初始补液后复评灌注（再充盈、花斑、意识）
maneuver.en: Reassess perfusion after the initial fluid boluses (refill, mottling, mental state)

finding.zh-CN: 初始液体推注后：甲床再充盈时间约3秒，膝部花斑较前变淡，手足仍偏凉；仍嗜睡、定向力差。当前血压与平均动脉压以监护仪读数为准。
finding.en: After the initial boluses: capillary refill about 3 s, the knee mottling is fading, hands and feet still cool; still drowsy and disoriented. Read the current blood pressure and MAP from the monitor.

maneuver.zh-CN: 延迟抗菌、补液后复评灌注（再充盈、花斑、意识）
maneuver.en: Reassess perfusion after the delayed antibiotics and fluid boluses (refill, mottling, mental state)

finding.zh-CN: 抗菌药物延迟后、液体推注后：甲床再充盈时间约5秒，花斑已蔓延至大腿中段，手足湿冷；叫名字才睁眼，很快又迷糊，答非所问。当前血压与平均动脉压以监护仪读数为准。
finding.en: After the delayed antibiotics and the boluses: capillary refill about 5 s, mottling now reaches mid-thigh, hands and feet cold and clammy; she opens her eyes only when called by name, drifts off again and gives muddled answers. Read the current blood pressure and MAP from the monitor.

maneuver.zh-CN: 补液后复评肺部与容量耐受
maneuver.en: Reassess the chest and fluid tolerance after boluses

finding.zh-CN: 右下肺支气管呼吸音和湿啰音同前；左肺底及其他肺野未出现新的湿啰音；颈静脉压不高；吸氧下仍呼吸偏快。
finding.en: Right lower zone bronchial breathing and crackles unchanged; no new crackles at the left base or elsewhere; JVP not raised; still breathing fast on oxygen.

text.zh-CN: 胸部CT平扫：右下叶大片实变伴支气管充气征，少量右侧游离胸腔积液（最大深度约1.5 cm），未见空洞、脓肿或分隔包裹；纵隔淋巴结反应性增大（短径≤9 mm）；左肺未见实变。平扫不能评估肺动脉栓塞。

name.zh-CN: 床旁超声（肺、心、下腔静脉）

text.zh-CN: 床旁超声：右侧后外侧肺底呈组织样改变（肝样变）伴动态支气管充气征，少量无回声胸腔积液；双侧前胸壁A线、胸膜滑动存在，未见弥漫B线。心脏：左室收缩活跃（高动力），无心包积液，右室不大。下腔静脉直径约1.2 cm，吸气塌陷率>50%。
text.en: POCUS: right posterolateral base shows a tissue-like (hepatised) pattern with dynamic air bronchograms and a small anechoic effusion; anterior chest bilaterally shows A-lines with lung sliding, no diffuse B-lines. Heart: hyperdynamic LV, no pericardial effusion, RV not dilated. IVC about 1.2 cm with > 50% inspiratory collapse.

note.zh-CN: 自主呼吸患者的下腔静脉变异度预测液体反应性的价值有限。
note.en: IVC variation in a spontaneously breathing patient is a weak predictor of fluid responsiveness.

text.zh-CN: 床旁超声（初始补液后）：右下肺实变同前；前胸壁仍为A线，未出现新的弥漫B线；左室收缩活跃，无心包积液；下腔静脉约1.6 cm，吸气塌陷约30–40%。
text.en: POCUS (after initial boluses): right lower lobe consolidation unchanged; anterior chest still A-lines with no new diffuse B-lines; hyperdynamic LV, no pericardial effusion; IVC about 1.6 cm with about 30–40% inspiratory collapse.

dose.en: Nasal cannula 4 L/min, target SpO₂ 94–98%

response.zh-CN: 鼻导管吸氧4 L/min，数分钟内SpO₂升至目标范围（94–98%）。
response.en: Nasal cannula at 4 L/min; within a few minutes SpO₂ rises into the 94–98% target range.

dose.zh-CN: 文丘里面罩 FiO₂ 0.40（按面罩标示流量），目标SpO₂ 94–98%
dose.en: Venturi mask FiO₂ 0.40 at the flow marked on the valve, target SpO₂ 94–98%

response.zh-CN: 改为文丘里面罩FiO₂ 0.40，SpO₂升至目标范围上限附近。
response.en: Switched to a Venturi mask at FiO₂ 0.40; SpO₂ rises towards the top of the target range.

dose.zh-CN: 储氧面罩 15 L/min（危重时初始使用，SpO₂稳定后应下调至94–98%）
dose.en: Reservoir mask 15 L/min (initial choice in critical illness; titrate down to 94–98% once stable)

response.zh-CN: 储氧面罩15 L/min，SpO₂很快升至100%。她无高碳酸血症风险，但应尽快下调至鼻导管或文丘里面罩，维持94–98%，避免高氧。
response.en: Reservoir mask at 15 L/min; SpO₂ quickly reaches 100%. She is not at risk of hypercapnia, but step down to nasal cannula or a Venturi mask as soon as possible to keep 94–98% and avoid hyperoxaemia.

dose.zh-CN: 担心肺炎/年龄而限制液体：仅维持液 80 mL/h
dose.en: Restrict fluids because of the pneumonia/age: maintenance only, 80 mL/h

harm.zh-CN: 低血压伴少尿、皮肤花斑和意识改变，是需要早期液体复苏的低灌注。仅给维持液会延长低灌注，加重乳酸酸中毒和急性肾损伤的风险。应分次推注平衡晶体液并反复复评。
harm.en: Hypotension with oliguria, mottling and new confusion is hypoperfusion that needs early fluid resuscitation. Maintenance fluid alone prolongs hypoperfusion and risks worsening lactic acidosis and acute kidney injury. Give balanced crystalloid in boluses with repeated reassessment.

response.zh-CN: 维持液以80 mL/h开始输注。
response.en: Maintenance fluid started at 80 mL/h.

name.zh-CN: 平衡晶体液 500 mL 快速推注

dose.zh-CN: 乳酸林格液或复方电解质注射液 500 mL 静脉输注，10–15分钟输完；每次推注后复评灌注与肺部。总目标约30 mL/kg（≈1800 mL），3小时内完成。
dose.en: Ringer's lactate or Plasma-Lyte 500 mL IV over 10–15 min; reassess perfusion and the chest after each bolus. Aim for about 30 mL/kg (≈ 1800 mL) within 3 h.

harm.zh-CN: 她已输入约2 L（>30 mL/kg）。初始复苏后，是否继续补液应以液体反应性的动态指标（如被动抬腿试验）指导；对于低氧的肺炎患者，继续经验性快速补液会加重肺水肿和低氧，却不能纠正血管麻痹——低血压持续时应开始或上调去甲肾上腺素。
harm.en: She has already had about 2 L (> 30 mL/kg). After initial resuscitation, further fluid should be guided by dynamic measures of fluid responsiveness (e.g. a passive leg raise); in a hypoxaemic patient with pneumonia, more empirical boluses worsen lung water and oxygenation without fixing vasoplegia — start or up-titrate norepinephrine for persistent hypotension.

response.zh-CN: 500 mL平衡晶体液快速输入。注意血压是否只是短暂上升；每次推注后复评再充盈时间、意识、尿量和肺部。
response.en: 500 mL of balanced crystalloid running in fast. Watch whether the blood pressure rises only transiently; reassess capillary refill, mental state, urine output and the chest after each bolus.

name.zh-CN: 头孢曲松 2 g 静脉滴注

dose.zh-CN: 头孢曲松 2 g 静脉滴注，每24小时一次（无需按肾功能调整）
dose.en: Ceftriaxone 2 g IV every 24 h (no renal dose adjustment needed)

response.zh-CN: 头孢曲松2 g已开始静脉滴注。记录首剂抗菌药物时间；如尚未留取血培养，应立即补留，但不要因此延误用药。
response.en: Ceftriaxone 2 g running IV. The time of the first antibiotic dose is recorded; if blood cultures have not been taken, take them now — but do not delay antibiotics for them.

name.zh-CN: 阿奇霉素 500 mg 静脉滴注

dose.zh-CN: 阿奇霉素 500 mg 静脉滴注，每24小时一次（无需按肾功能调整；注意QTc）
dose.en: Azithromycin 500 mg IV every 24 h (no renal adjustment; watch the QTc)

harm.zh-CN: 她已经在用莫西沙星覆盖非典型病原体。再加大环内酯类没有额外获益，反而叠加QT间期延长风险。
harm.en: Moxifloxacin already covers atypical organisms. Adding a macrolide gives no extra benefit and stacks QT-prolonging drugs.

response.zh-CN: 阿奇霉素500 mg已开始静脉滴注。注意：我国肺炎链球菌对大环内酯类耐药率很高，它在这里是联合β-内酰胺类使用，而不能单药覆盖。
response.en: Azithromycin 500 mg running IV. Note: macrolide resistance in Streptococcus pneumoniae is very common in China — here it is the partner to a β-lactam, not monotherapy.

name.zh-CN: 莫西沙星 400 mg 静脉滴注

dose.zh-CN: 莫西沙星 400 mg 静脉滴注，每24小时一次（无需按肾功能调整；注意QTc）
dose.en: Moxifloxacin 400 mg IV every 24 h (no renal adjustment; watch the QTc)

harm.zh-CN: 已经用了阿奇霉素，再加呼吸喹诺酮属于重复覆盖非典型病原体，并叠加QT延长风险。
harm.en: Azithromycin is already in. Adding a respiratory fluoroquinolone duplicates atypical cover and stacks QT-prolonging drugs.

response.zh-CN: 莫西沙星400 mg已开始静脉滴注。与β-内酰胺联合是重症CAP可接受的方案；单药用于需ICU的重症CAP不推荐。
response.en: Moxifloxacin 400 mg running IV. Combined with a β-lactam this is an acceptable severe-CAP regimen; as monotherapy it is not recommended for CAP severe enough to need ICU.

name.zh-CN: 哌拉西林他唑巴坦 4.5 g 静脉滴注

dose.zh-CN: 哌拉西林他唑巴坦 4.5 g 静脉滴注（首剂全量，后续按肾功能调整）
dose.en: Piperacillin–tazobactam 4.5 g IV (full first dose; later doses adjusted to renal function)

response.zh-CN: 哌拉西林他唑巴坦已开始滴注。它能覆盖肺炎链球菌，但她近3个月无住院或静脉抗生素使用、无铜绿假单胞菌分离史，抗铜绿方案过于广谱；仍需加用非典型病原体覆盖。
response.en: Piperacillin–tazobactam is running. It covers pneumococcus, but with no admission or IV antibiotics in the last 3 months and no previous Pseudomonas isolate, anti-pseudomonal cover is broader than needed — and atypical cover is still missing.

dose.zh-CN: 万古霉素负荷量 25 mg/kg（约1.5 g）静脉滴注
dose.en: Vancomycin loading dose 25 mg/kg (≈ 1.5 g) IV

response.zh-CN: 万古霉素已开始滴注。她没有MRSA定植/感染史，近期无住院或静脉抗生素——经验性抗MRSA并无指征，且有肾毒性（急性肾损伤时尤甚）。万古霉素也不能替代针对CAP的β-内酰胺类。
response.en: Vancomycin is running. She has no history of MRSA and no recent admission or IV antibiotics — empirical MRSA cover is not indicated, and vancomycin is nephrotoxic (especially in acute kidney injury). It does not replace a β-lactam for CAP.

name.en: Hold antibiotics until a chest CT is done

dose.zh-CN: 等待CT明确肺部病变后再开始抗菌药物
dose.en: Wait for CT confirmation of the lung lesion before starting antibiotics

harm.zh-CN: 观察性研究显示，疑似脓毒性休克患者抗菌药物每延迟一小时，死亡率随之升高。体征加上床旁胸片就足以定位肺部感染灶；不稳定患者外出CT既有转运风险，又推迟了抗菌药物。
harm.en: In suspected septic shock, observational data link each hour of antibiotic delay with higher mortality. Her signs plus a portable chest film are enough to localise the source; sending an unstable patient to CT adds transfer risk and postpones antibiotics.

response.zh-CN: 陈护士：好的，那抗生素先不配……（她看了一眼监护仪，面露担忧）
response.en: Nurse Chen: OK, I'll hold off drawing up the antibiotics… (she glances at the monitor, looking worried)

name.zh-CN: 去甲肾上腺素泵入（外周静脉起始）

dose.zh-CN: 去甲肾上腺素（以碱基计）4 mg 加入5%葡萄糖至250 mL（16 µg/mL），经近端粗外周静脉（≥20G，肘前/上臂）专用通路泵入；起始0.05 µg/kg/min（3 µg/min ≈ 11 mL/h），每5–10分钟按0.02–0.05 µg/kg/min调整，目标MAP ≥ 65 mmHg；每小时检查穿刺点有无外渗，尽早建立动脉及中心静脉通路。
dose.en: Norepinephrine (as base) 4 mg in 5% glucose to 250 mL (16 µg/mL) via a dedicated proximal large-bore peripheral cannula (≥ 20G, antecubital/upper arm) on a pump; start 0.05 µg/kg/min (3 µg/min ≈ 11 mL/h), titrate by 0.02–0.05 µg/kg/min every 5–10 min to MAP ≥ 65 mmHg; check the site hourly for extravasation and arrange arterial and central access early.

response.zh-CN: 去甲肾上腺素经左肘前18G留置针泵入。接下来约10分钟内平均动脉压逐渐上升——按MAP ≥ 65 mmHg滴定，并每小时检查穿刺点。
response.en: Norepinephrine running through the 18G cannula in the left antecubital fossa. Over the next 10 minutes or so the MAP climbs — titrate to MAP ≥ 65 mmHg and check the site hourly.

dose.zh-CN: 多巴胺 5–10 µg/kg/min 泵入
dose.en: Dopamine 5–10 µg/kg/min infusion

harm.zh-CN: 脓毒性休克首选去甲肾上腺素。与去甲肾上腺素相比，多巴胺心律失常更多、并无生存获益；她本已心动过速，多巴胺会进一步加快心率，可诱发快速性心律失常。
harm.en: Norepinephrine is the first-line vasopressor in septic shock. Compared with norepinephrine, dopamine causes more arrhythmias without a survival benefit; she is already tachycardic, and dopamine pushes the rate higher and can trigger tachyarrhythmias.

response.zh-CN: 多巴胺开始泵入，心率明显加快。
response.en: Dopamine started; her heart rate climbs noticeably.

dose.zh-CN: 氢化可的松 50 mg 静脉注射，每6小时一次（200 mg/d）
dose.en: Hydrocortisone 50 mg IV every 6 h (200 mg/day)

response.zh-CN: 氢化可的松50 mg已静脉注射，对血压没有即刻作用，不能替代升压药——补液后MAP仍<65 mmHg时应开始去甲肾上腺素。SSC 2021建议对持续需要升压药的脓毒性休克加用氢化可的松（200 mg/d）；重症CAP的糖皮质激素治疗（SCCM 2024重点更新）由ICU决定剂量和疗程。
response.en: Hydrocortisone 50 mg given IV. It has no immediate effect on blood pressure and does not replace a vasopressor — if MAP stays < 65 mmHg after fluids, start norepinephrine. SSC 2021 suggests adding hydrocortisone (200 mg/day) in septic shock with an ongoing vasopressor requirement; corticosteroids for severe CAP (SCCM 2024 focused update) are part of the ICU plan for dose and duration.

name.zh-CN: 对乙酰氨基酚静脉滴注（退热）

dose.zh-CN: 对乙酰氨基酚 1 g 静脉滴注（15分钟），必要时重复，间隔至少6小时（肌酐清除率≤30 mL/min）；存在脱水、进食差等肝毒性危险因素，24小时不超过3 g
dose.en: Paracetamol 1 g IV over 15 min, repeated if needed at least 6 h apart (creatinine clearance ≤ 30 mL/min); max 3 g/24 h because dehydration and poor intake are risk factors for hepatotoxicity

response.zh-CN: 对乙酰氨基酚1 g静脉滴注。退热改善舒适度，也可略微降低心率和耗氧；避免再用布洛芬等NSAIDs（急性肾损伤）。
response.en: Paracetamol 1 g IV. Treating the fever improves comfort and slightly lowers heart rate and oxygen demand; avoid further ibuprofen or other NSAIDs (acute kidney injury).

name.zh-CN: 留置导尿，监测每小时尿量
name.en: Urinary catheter with hourly urine output

dose.zh-CN: 留置导尿，记录每小时尿量（目标≥0.5 mL/kg/h，即≥30 mL/h）
dose.en: Urinary catheter; record hourly urine output (target ≥ 0.5 mL/kg/h, i.e. ≥ 30 mL/h)

response.zh-CN: 导尿管已留置，引流出少量深色尿液，开始记录每小时尿量。
response.en: Catheter in; a small amount of dark urine drains, and hourly urine output monitoring starts.

name.zh-CN: 桡动脉置管有创血压监测

dose.zh-CN: 超声引导下桡动脉置管，持续有创动脉压监测
dose.en: Ultrasound-guided radial arterial line for continuous invasive BP

response.zh-CN: 动脉置管完成，监护仪显示有创动脉压。不要因置管而推迟升压药的开始。
response.en: Arterial line in and transducing. Never delay starting the vasopressor for the line.

name.zh-CN: 快速顺序诱导气管插管

dose.zh-CN: 快速顺序诱导气管插管 + 机械通气
dose.en: Rapid-sequence induction, intubation and mechanical ventilation

harm.zh-CN: 只要她还能保护气道、吸氧后氧合可达标，就没有插管指征；在未用升压药纠正的休克中诱导插管极易引起严重低血压甚至心搏骤停。若病情进展需要插管，应先复苏，并在升压药运行下进行。
harm.en: While she can protect her airway and oxygenates on supplemental oxygen there is no indication to intubate, and inducing anaesthesia in shock without a vasopressor running risks profound hypotension or arrest. If she later needs intubation, resuscitate first and intubate with a vasopressor running.

response.zh-CN: 诱导后血压骤降，插管完成，开始机械通气。
response.en: Her blood pressure drops sharply on induction; she is intubated and ventilated.

name.zh-CN: 暂停二甲双胍和降压药，避免NSAIDs
name.en: Hold metformin and antihypertensives; avoid NSAIDs

dose.zh-CN: 暂停二甲双胍和氨氯地平；避免布洛芬等NSAIDs及其他肾毒性药物；医嘱中注明原因
dose.en: Withhold metformin and amlodipine; avoid ibuprofen and other NSAIDs or nephrotoxins; document why

response.zh-CN: 已在医嘱中暂停二甲双胍和氨氯地平，并标注避免NSAIDs。休克和急性肾损伤时二甲双胍增加乳酸酸中毒风险，降压药会加重低血压。
response.en: Metformin and amlodipine are held on the chart, with NSAIDs flagged to avoid. In shock with AKI, metformin adds lactic-acidosis risk and antihypertensives worsen hypotension.

dose.zh-CN: 电话联系ICU住院总，SBAR交班并申请床位
dose.en: Phone the ICU registrar, give an SBAR handover and request a bed

response.zh-CN: ICU孙医生接听：听完你的SBAR交班后同意收治，约30–45分钟内有床位。她请你在转运前把MAP维持在65 mmHg以上（必要时开始或上调去甲肾上腺素）、复查乳酸，同时与家属沟通病情和治疗目标。
response.en: ICU registrar Dr Sun takes your SBAR handover and accepts her; a bed will be ready in about 30–45 minutes. Until transfer she asks you to keep the MAP ≥ 65 mmHg (starting or titrating norepinephrine as needed), repeat the lactate, and talk with the family about severity and goals of care.

name.en: Admit to a general respiratory ward

dose.zh-CN: 收入普通呼吸科病房继续治疗
dose.en: Admit to a general respiratory ward

harm.zh-CN: 补液后仍需升压药维持血压的休克本身就符合ATS/IDSA重症CAP的主要标准，应收入ICU；普通病房无法提供升压药滴定和密切监测。
harm.en: Shock that still needs a vasopressor after fluids is itself an ATS/IDSA major criterion for severe CAP — she needs ICU; a general ward cannot titrate vasopressors or monitor her closely enough.

response.zh-CN: 病房护士长来电：病房没有升压药泵入和有创监测条件，要求重新评估去向。
response.en: The ward nurse-in-charge calls back: the ward cannot run vasopressors or invasive monitoring and asks you to reconsider.

message.zh-CN: 陈护士：两套血培养已从两个不同部位抽好送检了（每套需氧瓶加厌氧瓶）。抗生素随时可以给。
message.en: Nurse Chen: Two sets of blood cultures are off from two different sites (aerobic and anaerobic bottle each). Antibiotics can go in whenever you're ready.

message.zh-CN: 陈护士：两套血培养抽好送检了——不过是在第一剂抗菌药物之后抽的，阳性率会打折扣。
message.en: Nurse Chen: Two sets of blood cultures are off — but they were drawn after the first antibiotic dose, so the yield will be lower.

message.zh-CN: 陈护士：CT室说大约30分钟后能做，她血压这么低，转运要全程监护。抗生素是要等CT做完再用吗？
message.en: Nurse Chen: CT says they can take her in about 30 minutes — with her pressure this low she'll need a monitored transfer. Are the antibiotics waiting until after the scan?

message.zh-CN: 陈护士：医生，她进抢救室已经半小时了，经验性抗菌药物用哪种？药房可以马上送来。
message.en: Nurse Chen: Doctor, she's been in resus for half an hour — which empirical antibiotics do you want? Pharmacy can send them straight away.

message.zh-CN: 陈护士：进抢救室已经一个小时了，经验性抗菌方案还没到位！她越来越叫不醒，花斑已经蔓延到大腿，血压还在往下掉。
message.en: Nurse Chen: She's been in resus for an hour and the empirical antibiotic regimen still isn't in! She's getting harder to rouse, the mottling has spread up her thighs and her pressure keeps falling.

message.zh-CN: 陈护士：她现在只对疼痛有反应，四肢冰冷，花斑一直到大腿根——濒临心搏骤停！马上叫上级医生！
message.en: Nurse Chen: She's only responding to pain now, her limbs are ice-cold and mottled up to the groin — she's peri-arrest! Get senior help now!

message.zh-CN: 赵药师（电话）：氢化可的松已经发出去了。不过她的平均动脉压还低，激素不会很快把血压升上来——升压药准备用吗？
message.en: Pharmacist Zhao (phone): The hydrocortisone has gone up. But her MAP is still low, and steroids won't bring the pressure up quickly — are you starting a vasopressor?

message.zh-CN: 监护仪报警：新出现绝对不规则的窄QRS心动过速——心房颤动伴快速心室率。
message.en: Monitor alarm: a new irregularly irregular narrow-complex tachycardia — atrial fibrillation with a fast ventricular rate.

message.zh-CN: 陈护士：她更喘了，我听着两肺底都有湿啰音了。还要继续推液体吗？
message.en: Nurse Chen: She's more breathless — I can hear crackles at both bases now. Do you still want more fluid?

message.zh-CN: 陈护士：最初的几袋液体已经推进去了，抗生素也在滴。要再评估一下她吗？最新血压在监护仪上。
message.en: Nurse Chen: The first bags of fluid are in and the antibiotics are running. Do you want to reassess her? The latest BP is on the monitor.

message.zh-CN: 陈护士：抗生素终于用上了，几袋液体也推进去了，可她还是叫不太醒，花斑一直到大腿。要再评估一下吗？最新血压在监护仪上。
message.en: Nurse Chen: The antibiotics are finally in and the boluses are through, but she's still hard to rouse and mottled up to her thighs. Do you want to reassess her? The latest BP is on the monitor.

message.zh-CN: 陈护士：抢救室快满了，她的去向定了吗？ICU那边还没人联系过。
message.en: Nurse Chen: Resus is filling up — where is she going? Nobody has called ICU yet.

hint.zh-CN: 先处理危及生命的问题：吸氧、上监护、建立静脉通路；看一般情况、听肺、评估外周灌注。
hint.en: Deal with threats to life first: oxygen, monitor, IV access; then look at her, listen to the chest and assess peripheral perfusion.

guidance.zh-CN: 到抢救室1床：给氧、连接监护、开放两条静脉通路，并完成一般情况、肺部和灌注评估。
guidance.en: Go to resus bay 1: give oxygen, attach the monitor, get two IV lines, and assess her general state, chest and perfusion.

title.zh-CN: 向病人和女儿采集重点病史
title.en: Focused history from the patient and her daughter

hint.zh-CN: 她意识模糊，女儿能补充细节。抓住：发热、咳嗽咳痰、胸痛特点、意识改变的时间和基线、既往史、用药和过敏。
hint.en: She is confused — her daughter can fill in. Cover fever, cough and sputum, the character of the chest pain, the timing of the confusion and her baseline, past history, medications and allergies.

guidance.zh-CN: 边复苏边问诊：问清病程、平时认知水平、慢性病、用药和过敏。
guidance.en: Take the history while resuscitating: the course, her usual cognition, chronic illnesses, medications and allergies.

title.zh-CN: 初步检查：病因与器官功能
title.en: Initial investigations: cause and organ function

hint.zh-CN: 乳酸要马上测；抗生素前留两套血培养；血常规、生化（肾功能）和胸片帮助确定感染灶和器官功能。
hint.en: Measure lactate now; take two sets of blood cultures before antibiotics; the blood count, chemistry (renal function) and chest film locate the source and the organ dysfunction.

guidance.zh-CN: 开具静脉血气+乳酸、血培养、血常规、生化和床旁胸片；乳酸几分钟就出结果，先看乳酸，其余结果出来后逐一阅读。
guidance.en: Order a venous gas with lactate, blood cultures, blood count, chemistry and a portable chest film; the lactate is back within minutes — read it first, then the rest as they return.

hint.zh-CN: 低血压+乳酸升高：在不明显延误的前提下先留血培养，然后1小时内静脉经验性抗菌药物（β-内酰胺+大环内酯），并开始分次推注平衡晶体液，每次后复评。
hint.en: Hypotension plus raised lactate: blood cultures first if they cause no delay, then IV empirical antibiotics within the hour (β-lactam plus macrolide) and balanced crystalloid in boluses, reassessing after each.

guidance.zh-CN: 在决策板上确定抗菌药物时机和方案，然后给药；完成至少三次500 mL液体推注。
guidance.en: Settle antibiotic timing and regimen on the decision board, give them, and complete at least three 500 mL boluses.

hint.zh-CN: 初始补液后复评：MAP仍<65 mmHg时开始去甲肾上腺素（可经外周起始），复查乳酸，并按Sepsis-3重新归类。
hint.en: Reassess after the initial fluids: if MAP stays < 65 mmHg start norepinephrine (a peripheral start is fine), repeat the lactate, and reclassify her using Sepsis-3.

guidance.zh-CN: 复评灌注，决定升压策略，开始去甲肾上腺素，复查乳酸，并在决策板上完成Sepsis-3判断。
guidance.en: Reassess perfusion, decide on the vasopressor, start norepinephrine, repeat the lactate and complete the Sepsis-3 question on the board.

hint.zh-CN: 用分诊时的数据算CURB-65；需要升压药本身就是重症CAP的主要标准。SBAR联系ICU，并和女儿沟通。
hint.en: Score CURB-65 from the triage data; needing a vasopressor is itself a major criterion for severe CAP. Refer to ICU with an SBAR and talk with her daughter.

guidance.zh-CN: 阅读胸片，完成CURB-65判断，电话联系ICU交班，并向家属解释病情。
guidance.en: Read the chest film, complete the CURB-65 question, phone the ICU handover and explain the situation to the family.

prompt.zh-CN: 她低血压、乳酸升高、新发意识改变，查体提示肺部感染灶。关于留取培养和经验性抗菌药物的时机，哪项最恰当？
prompt.en: She is hypotensive with a raised lactate and new confusion, and the examination points to a chest source. Which approach to cultures and empirical antibiotics is best?

need.zh-CN: 先完成肺部听诊，并拿到静脉血气/乳酸结果。
need.en: Auscultate the chest and get the venous gas/lactate result first.

text.zh-CN: 立即留取两套血培养（不因此延误），并在识别休克后1小时内尽快静脉给予经验性抗菌药物
text.en: Take two sets of blood cultures now (without delaying treatment) and give IV empirical antibiotics as soon as possible, within 1 hour of recognising shock

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。SSC 2021：对可能的脓毒性休克或高度可能的脓毒症，建议识别后1小时内给予抗菌药物；在不明显延误的前提下先留取血培养。观察性研究显示，休克患者抗菌药物每延迟一小时，死亡率随之升高。
feedback.en: Correct. SSC 2021 recommends antimicrobials within 1 hour of recognising possible septic shock or probable sepsis, with blood cultures first provided this causes no substantial delay. In shock, observational data link each hour of delay with higher mortality.

text.zh-CN: 先送胸部CT明确肺炎范围，再决定是否用抗生素
text.en: Send her for a chest CT to define the pneumonia first, then decide on antibiotics

feedback.zh-CN: 不妥。体征和床旁胸片足以确定肺部感染灶；不稳定患者外出CT既有转运风险，又延误抗菌药物。CT在本例中不改变急诊处理。
feedback.en: No. Her signs and a portable chest film localise the source; sending an unstable patient to CT adds transfer risk and delays antibiotics. CT does not change ED management here.

text.zh-CN: 等降钙素原结果：PCT > 0.5 µg/L 再开始抗生素
text.en: Wait for the procalcitonin: start antibiotics only if PCT > 0.5 µg/L

feedback.zh-CN: 不妥。SSC 2021不建议用PCT联合临床评估来决定是否启动抗菌药物；休克患者不能等待。PCT更多用于辅助判断疗程和停药。
feedback.en: No. SSC 2021 advises against using procalcitonin plus clinical evaluation to decide when to start antimicrobials; a shocked patient cannot wait. PCT is more useful for deciding duration and discontinuation.

text.zh-CN: 她血压还能测到，3小时内给药即可
text.en: Her blood pressure is still recordable, so giving antibiotics within 3 hours is fine

feedback.zh-CN: 不妥。3小时的时间窗适用于可能脓毒症但无休克、且感染可能性不确定的情况。她低血压伴乳酸4.6 mmol/L，应在1小时内用药。
feedback.en: No. The 3-hour window applies to possible sepsis without shock when infection is uncertain. She is hypotensive with a lactate of 4.6 mmol/L — antibiotics belong within the hour.

text.zh-CN: 等血培养报阳、拿到药敏后再针对性用药
text.en: Wait for positive blood cultures and susceptibilities, then treat specifically

feedback.zh-CN: 不妥。血培养需要24–72小时；经验性治疗不能等待，结果回报后再降阶梯。
feedback.en: No. Cultures take 24–72 hours; empirical treatment cannot wait — de-escalate once results return.

prompt.zh-CN: 她无药物过敏，近3个月无住院、无静脉或口服抗生素使用，既往无MRSA或铜绿假单胞菌分离史。按需要ICU的重症社区获得性肺炎，以下哪些经验性方案合适？（选出所有合适项）
prompt.en: She has no drug allergies, no admission and no IV or oral antibiotics in the last 3 months, and no previous MRSA or Pseudomonas isolate. For CAP severe enough to need ICU, which empirical regimens are appropriate? (Select all that apply)

need.zh-CN: 先问清过敏史和近期住院/抗生素使用情况，并完成肺部听诊或阅读胸片。
need.en: Ask about allergies and recent admissions/antibiotics, and auscultate the chest or read the chest film first.

text.zh-CN: 头孢曲松 2 g IV q24h + 阿奇霉素 500 mg IV q24h
text.en: Ceftriaxone 2 g IV q24h + azithromycin 500 mg IV q24h

feedback.zh-CN: 合适。β-内酰胺+大环内酯是重症CAP首选方案之一；两药均无需按肾功能调整剂量，适合目前肌酐升高的情况。
feedback.en: Appropriate. A β-lactam plus a macrolide is a preferred severe-CAP regimen; neither drug needs renal dose adjustment, which suits her raised creatinine.

text.zh-CN: 头孢曲松 2 g IV q24h + 莫西沙星 400 mg IV q24h
text.en: Ceftriaxone 2 g IV q24h + moxifloxacin 400 mg IV q24h

feedback.zh-CN: 合适（替代方案）。β-内酰胺+呼吸喹诺酮同样被指南接受；需关注QTc及药物相互作用。部分观察性研究提示β-内酰胺+大环内酯在重症CAP中结局更好。
feedback.en: Appropriate (alternative). A β-lactam plus a respiratory fluoroquinolone is also guideline-endorsed; mind the QTc and interactions. Some observational data favour β-lactam plus macrolide in severe CAP.

text.zh-CN: 莫西沙星单药
text.en: Moxifloxacin alone

feedback.zh-CN: 不合适。呼吸喹诺酮单药可用于非重症住院CAP；对需要ICU的重症CAP，指南推荐联合方案。
feedback.en: Not appropriate. Fluoroquinolone monotherapy is an option for non-severe inpatient CAP; for CAP needing ICU, guidelines recommend combination therapy.

text.zh-CN: 美罗培南 + 万古霉素
text.en: Meropenem + vancomycin

feedback.zh-CN: 不合适。她没有MRSA或铜绿假单胞菌危险因素，此方案过于广谱，且漏掉非典型病原体；万古霉素在急性肾损伤时增加肾毒性。
feedback.en: Not appropriate. She has no MRSA or Pseudomonas risk factors; this is needlessly broad, misses atypical organisms, and vancomycin adds nephrotoxicity in AKI.

text.zh-CN: 阿奇霉素单药
text.en: Azithromycin alone

feedback.zh-CN: 不合适。我国肺炎链球菌对大环内酯类耐药率很高，重症CAP也不推荐单药治疗。
feedback.en: Not appropriate. Pneumococcal macrolide resistance in China is very high, and severe CAP should not be treated with monotherapy.

text.zh-CN: 口服阿莫西林 1 g tid
text.en: Oral amoxicillin 1 g three times daily

feedback.zh-CN: 不合适。休克时胃肠吸收不可靠，且不覆盖非典型病原体；重症CAP应静脉给药。
feedback.en: Not appropriate. Oral absorption is unreliable in shock and atypical organisms are not covered; severe CAP needs IV therapy.

prompt.zh-CN: 初始液体推注后复评：如果平均动脉压仍<65 mmHg（或只是短暂上升后又回落），首选的升压策略是什么？
prompt.en: Reassessing after the initial fluid boluses: if the MAP is still < 65 mmHg (or rose only transiently and fell back), what is the preferred vasopressor strategy?

need.zh-CN: 先完成至少三次500 mL液体推注。
need.en: Give at least three 500 mL boluses first.

text.zh-CN: 经近端粗外周静脉（≥20G）立即开始去甲肾上腺素，目标MAP ≥ 65 mmHg，随后再建立动脉和中心静脉通路
text.en: Start norepinephrine now through a proximal large-bore peripheral cannula (≥ 20G), target MAP ≥ 65 mmHg, and place arterial and central lines afterwards

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。去甲肾上腺素是一线升压药；SSC 2021建议不必等待中心静脉，可经外周静脉起始，目标MAP 65 mmHg，并尽早建立动脉监测。
feedback.en: Correct. Norepinephrine is first line; SSC 2021 suggests starting it peripherally rather than waiting for central access, targeting a MAP of 65 mmHg, with arterial monitoring as soon as practical.

text.zh-CN: 首选多巴胺
text.en: Dopamine first line

feedback.zh-CN: 不妥。与去甲肾上腺素相比，多巴胺心律失常更多、无生存获益；仅在极少数特定情况下使用。
feedback.en: No. Compared with norepinephrine, dopamine causes more arrhythmias with no survival benefit; it is reserved for very selected situations.

text.zh-CN: 继续每次500 mL快速推注，直到MAP ≥ 65 mmHg，不设上限
text.en: Keep giving 500 mL boluses until MAP ≥ 65 mmHg, with no upper limit

feedback.zh-CN: 不妥。初始约30 mL/kg后，进一步补液应以动态指标指导。在低氧的肺炎患者中盲目补液会加重肺水肿；血管麻痹需要升压药。
feedback.en: No. After about 30 mL/kg, further fluid should be guided by dynamic measures. Empirical fluid in a hypoxaemic pneumonia patient worsens lung water; vasoplegia needs a vasopressor.

text.zh-CN: 先用氢化可的松，观察血压是否回升，再决定是否用升压药
text.en: Give hydrocortisone first, see whether the pressure recovers, then decide on a vasopressor

feedback.zh-CN: 不妥。激素起效慢，不能替代升压药，也不能及时纠正MAP——应先开始去甲肾上腺素。SSC 2021建议在持续需要升压药（如去甲肾上腺素≥0.25 µg/kg/min且≥4小时）时加用氢化可的松；重症CAP的激素治疗是ICU的后续决策，而不是升压药的替代。
feedback.en: No. Steroids act slowly and neither replace a vasopressor nor restore MAP in time — start norepinephrine. SSC 2021 suggests adding hydrocortisone for an ongoing vasopressor requirement (e.g. norepinephrine ≥ 0.25 µg/kg/min for ≥ 4 h); steroids for severe CAP are a later ICU decision, never a substitute for a vasopressor.

text.zh-CN: 等中心静脉置管完成后再开始任何升压药
text.en: Wait until a central line is in before starting any vasopressor

feedback.zh-CN: 不妥。等待中心静脉会延长低血压时间。短时间经近端粗外周静脉输注去甲肾上腺素是可接受且安全的做法（需监测外渗）。
feedback.en: No. Waiting for a central line prolongs hypotension. Short-term norepinephrine through a proximal large-bore peripheral cannula is acceptable and safe with extravasation checks.

text.zh-CN: 首选血管加压素单药
text.en: Vasopressin alone as first line

feedback.zh-CN: 不妥。血管加压素是二线药物：当去甲肾上腺素达到0.25–0.5 µg/kg/min仍不足时加用，而不是替代去甲肾上腺素。
feedback.en: No. Vasopressin is second line — added when norepinephrine reaches 0.25–0.5 µg/kg/min and MAP is still inadequate, not used instead of it.

prompt.zh-CN: 按Sepsis-3定义，以下哪项最准确地描述了她现在的状态？
prompt.en: Using the Sepsis-3 definitions, which statement best describes her now?

need.zh-CN: 先拿到乳酸、血常规和生化（器官功能）结果，处理补液后仍存在的低血压，并在初始复苏后复查乳酸。
need.en: Get the lactate, blood count and chemistry (organ function) results, act on the hypotension that persists after fluids, and repeat the lactate after initial resuscitation first.

text.zh-CN: 脓毒性休克：感染导致SOFA急性增加≥2分（即脓毒症），且充分液体复苏后仍需血管活性药物维持MAP ≥ 65 mmHg，同时血乳酸>2 mmol/L
text.en: Septic shock: infection with an acute SOFA rise ≥ 2 (sepsis), plus a vasopressor needed to keep MAP ≥ 65 mmHg despite adequate fluid resuscitation, with lactate > 2 mmol/L

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。即便不计呼吸项，她的SOFA也已≥4分：GCS 14（1分）、MAP < 70 mmHg（1分；使用去甲肾上腺素≤0.1 µg/kg/min时为3分）、肌酐156 µmol/L（1分）、血小板132×10⁹/L（1分）——较基线急性增加远超2分（若查了胆红素，还可能再加分）。补液后仍需去甲肾上腺素维持MAP，且初始补液后复查乳酸仍>2 mmol/L——符合脓毒性休克。
feedback.en: Correct. Even without the respiratory component her SOFA is already ≥ 4: GCS 14 (1), MAP < 70 mmHg (1; 3 on norepinephrine ≤ 0.1 µg/kg/min), creatinine 156 µmol/L (1) and platelets 132 ×10⁹/L (1) — an acute rise of well over 2 (bilirubin, if you checked it, may add more). She still needs norepinephrine to hold the MAP after fluids, and her repeat lactate after initial fluids is still > 2 mmol/L — septic shock.

text.zh-CN: SIRS ≥ 2项 + 感染 = 脓毒症；收缩压<90 mmHg 即为脓毒性休克
text.en: SIRS ≥ 2 plus infection = sepsis; systolic BP < 90 mmHg = septic shock

feedback.zh-CN: 不妥。这是Sepsis-1/2的旧定义。Sepsis-3以感染相关器官功能障碍（SOFA≥2）定义脓毒症，休克需同时满足升压药依赖和乳酸>2 mmol/L。
feedback.en: No. That is the old Sepsis-1/2 framework. Sepsis-3 defines sepsis by infection-related organ dysfunction (SOFA ≥ 2); shock needs both vasopressor dependence and lactate > 2 mmol/L.

text.zh-CN: qSOFA 3分即可诊断脓毒性休克
text.en: A qSOFA of 3 establishes septic shock

feedback.zh-CN: 不妥。qSOFA（呼吸≥22、意识改变、收缩压≤100）只是床旁预后/警示工具，并非诊断标准；SSC 2021不建议单独用qSOFA作为筛查工具。
feedback.en: No. qSOFA (RR ≥ 22, altered mentation, SBP ≤ 100) is a bedside prognostic prompt, not a diagnostic criterion; SSC 2021 recommends against using it alone as a screening tool.

text.zh-CN: 乳酸≥4 mmol/L本身就定义了脓毒性休克，与血压和升压药无关
text.en: A lactate ≥ 4 mmol/L defines septic shock by itself, regardless of blood pressure or vasopressors

feedback.zh-CN: 不妥。乳酸≥4 mmol/L提示严重低灌注、需要积极复苏，但Sepsis-3的脓毒性休克需要“补液后仍需升压药维持MAP≥65”与“乳酸>2”两者同时满足。
feedback.en: No. A lactate ≥ 4 mmol/L signals severe hypoperfusion that needs aggressive resuscitation, but Sepsis-3 septic shock requires both vasopressor dependence after fluids and lactate > 2.

text.zh-CN: 严重脓毒症（severe sepsis）
text.en: Severe sepsis

feedback.zh-CN: 不妥。Sepsis-3已取消“严重脓毒症”这一类别。
feedback.en: No. Sepsis-3 abolished the 'severe sepsis' category.

prompt.zh-CN: 用就诊（分诊）时的资料计算CURB-65，并据此判断严重程度和去向：
prompt.en: Using the presentation (triage) data, calculate CURB-65 and decide severity and disposition:

need.zh-CN: 先问清意识改变的情况，并阅读生化结果（尿素）。
need.en: Clarify the confusion history and read the chemistry (urea) first.

text.zh-CN: 4分（新发意识模糊、尿素>7 mmol/L、收缩压<90 mmHg、年龄≥65岁）——高危，按重症CAP收入ICU
text.en: 4 (new confusion, urea > 7 mmol/L, systolic BP < 90 mmHg, age ≥ 65) — high risk; admit to ICU as severe CAP

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。分诊时RR 28次/分（<30，不计分）。另外，需要升压药是ATS/IDSA重症CAP的主要标准；她还满足3项次要标准（意识障碍、尿素升高即BUN约33 mg/dL、需积极补液的低血压）。
feedback.en: Correct. Her triage RR was 28/min (< 30, scores 0). Needing a vasopressor is also an ATS/IDSA major criterion for severe CAP, and she meets 3 minor criteria (confusion, uraemia — BUN about 33 mg/dL — and hypotension needing aggressive fluids).

text.zh-CN: 5分（呼吸频率也计1分）——高危
text.en: 5 (respiratory rate also scores) — high risk

feedback.zh-CN: 不妥。CURB-65的R需要呼吸频率≥30次/分，她分诊时为28次/分。严重程度判断正确，但计分错误。
feedback.en: No. The R criterion needs a respiratory rate ≥ 30/min; hers was 28/min at triage. The severity is right but the arithmetic is not.

text.zh-CN: 3分——收入普通病房即可
text.en: 3 — a general ward is fine

feedback.zh-CN: 不妥。计分有误；而且无论CURB-65多少分，需要升压药的脓毒性休克都应收入ICU。
feedback.en: No. The score is wrong, and regardless of CURB-65, septic shock needing a vasopressor belongs in ICU.

text.zh-CN: 2分——可考虑短期住院或门诊口服治疗
text.en: 2 — consider a short stay or oral outpatient treatment

feedback.zh-CN: 不妥。明显低估：意识模糊、尿素升高、低血压和年龄各计1分。
feedback.en: No. A gross underestimate: confusion, raised urea, hypotension and age each score a point.

text.zh-CN: 问清发热、咳嗽咳痰、胸膜性胸痛和新发意识模糊的时间线
text.en: Established the timeline of fever, productive cough, pleuritic chest pain and new confusion

text.zh-CN: 用药前问清过敏史、长期用药和近期住院/抗生素使用（决定方案和耐药风险）
text.en: Before prescribing, asked about allergies, regular medications and recent admissions/antibiotics (regimen and resistance risk)

text.zh-CN: 完成肺部听诊、外周灌注评估和神经系统检查
text.en: Auscultated the chest, assessed peripheral perfusion and examined the nervous system

text.zh-CN: 通过体征和胸片定位肺部感染灶，并按Sepsis-3正确归类为脓毒性休克（首次作答即正确）
text.en: Localised a pulmonary source from the signs and chest film, and classified septic shock correctly by Sepsis-3 (first attempt)

text.zh-CN: 抗菌药物时机、升压策略和CURB-65三道决策题均首次作答正确
text.en: Answered the antibiotic-timing, vasopressor and CURB-65 decisions correctly at the first attempt

text.zh-CN: 给氧并将SpO₂滴定到94–98%（无高碳酸血症风险）
text.en: Gave oxygen and titrated SpO₂ to 94–98% (no hypercapnia risk)

text.zh-CN: 测定初始乳酸，并在复苏后复查
text.en: Measured the initial lactate and repeated it after resuscitation

text.zh-CN: 首剂抗菌药物前留取两套血培养
text.en: Took two sets of blood cultures before the first antibiotic dose

text.zh-CN: 到达抢救室60分钟内给予有效的静脉经验性抗菌药物
text.en: Gave effective IV empirical antibiotics within 60 minutes of reaching resus

text.zh-CN: 方案包含β-内酰胺并覆盖非典型病原体（大环内酯或呼吸喹诺酮）
text.en: Regimen included a β-lactam plus atypical cover (macrolide or respiratory fluoroquinolone)

text.zh-CN: 分次推注平衡晶体液（≥3×500 mL，向30 mL/kg推进）并复评灌注
text.en: Gave balanced crystalloid in boluses (≥ 3 × 500 mL, working towards 30 mL/kg) and reassessed perfusion

text.zh-CN: 补液后持续低血压时以去甲肾上腺素作为一线升压药（未用多巴胺）
text.en: Used norepinephrine as the first-line vasopressor for hypotension persisting after fluids (no dopamine)

text.zh-CN: 避免有害选择：限制补液、为CT延误抗生素、无指征插管、收普通病房
text.en: Avoided harmful choices: fluid restriction, delaying antibiotics for CT, unindicated intubation, ward admission

text.zh-CN: 问出在家自行服用布洛芬，并暂停二甲双胍、降压药和NSAIDs（休克合并急性肾损伤）
text.en: Found the home ibuprofen use and held metformin, the antihypertensive and NSAIDs (shock with acute kidney injury)

text.zh-CN: 到达抢救室90分钟内联系ICU
text.en: Referred to ICU within 90 minutes of reaching resus

text.zh-CN: 与病人和女儿沟通：解释病情严重性和ICU的必要性，回应“老伴独自在家”的担忧，初步了解治疗意愿
text.en: Talked with the patient and daughter: explained how serious this is and why ICU, addressed the worry about her husband alone at home, and opened a goals-of-care conversation

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 优秀表现：用通俗语言说明“肺部感染引起全身严重反应、血压低、需要升压药和ICU监护”；不使用术语堆砌；询问并回应女儿对ICU和预后的担心，安排有人照看在家的父亲（如联系亲属/社区）；询问是否讨论过治疗意愿，记录“家属希望全力治疗”；核实理解（teach-back）。
judgeGuidance.en: Good performance: plain-language explanation ('a severe lung infection causing a whole-body reaction, low blood pressure needing a drip to support it and ICU monitoring'); avoids jargon; asks about and responds to the daughter's ICU and prognosis worries; helps arrange someone to check on her father at home (relatives/community); asks whether goals of care were ever discussed and documents that the family wants full treatment; checks understanding (teach-back).

text.zh-CN: 团队沟通：闭环口头医嘱，并用SBAR向ICU交班
text.en: Team communication: closed-loop verbal orders and an SBAR handover to ICU

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 优秀表现：对护士下达药名、剂量、途径和时间明确的医嘱并要求复述；SBAR包含：情况（72岁女性，右下叶CAP致脓毒性休克）、背景（高血压、糖尿病、二甲双胍、AKI）、评估（MAP、去甲肾上腺素剂量、乳酸趋势、氧需求、尿量、CURB-65 4分）、建议（收ICU、动脉/中心静脉通路、继续滴定）。
judgeGuidance.en: Good performance: clear orders to the nurse with drug, dose, route and timing, asking for read-back; an SBAR with Situation (72-year-old woman, septic shock from right lower lobe CAP), Background (hypertension, diabetes, metformin, AKI), Assessment (MAP, norepinephrine dose, lactate trend, oxygen need, urine output, CURB-65 4) and Recommendation (ICU admission, arterial/central access, continued titration).

knowledge.zh-CN: 分诊交班：72岁女性，女儿打车送来，21:25到院；发热咳嗽2天、今天下午起说胡话；分诊（未吸氧）T 39.1 ℃、HR 118、BP 84/48、RR 28、SpO₂ 89%、GCS 14，NEWS2 16分，直接入抢救室1床；尚未建立静脉通路、未用药；女儿估计体重约60 kg，手机里有药单。抢救室1床有监护仪、墙壁氧气和负压吸引、两台输液泵；血培养瓶在抢救室柜子里；急诊药房备有头孢曲松、阿奇霉素、莫西沙星、哌拉西林他唑巴坦、万古霉素和去甲肾上腺素，约5分钟送到。医院规定去甲肾上腺素可经近端粗外周静脉短期输注，需每小时检查穿刺点。床旁胸片约20分钟出报告；CT需等约30分钟并需监护转运；ICU住院总可电话联系。会复述医嘱（闭环沟通），只报告结果数值，不解读、不给出诊断。
knowledge.en: Triage handover: 72-year-old woman brought by her daughter by taxi, arrived 21:25; fever and cough for 2 days, talking nonsense since this afternoon; triage on room air T 39.1 °C, HR 118, BP 84/48, RR 28, SpO₂ 89%, GCS 14, NEWS2 16, straight to resus bay 1; no IV access or medication yet; daughter estimates her weight at about 60 kg and has the medication list on her phone. Resus bay 1 has a monitor, wall oxygen and suction, and two infusion pumps; blood culture bottles are in the resus cupboard; the ED pharmacy stocks ceftriaxone, azithromycin, moxifloxacin, piperacillin–tazobactam, vancomycin and norepinephrine and can deliver in about 5 minutes. Hospital policy allows short-term norepinephrine through a proximal large-bore peripheral cannula with hourly site checks. A portable chest film is reported in about 20 minutes; CT has a ~30-minute wait and needs a monitored transfer; the ICU registrar can be phoned. She reads back orders (closed loop), reports result values only, and does not interpret or diagnose.

knowledge.zh-CN: 苏格拉底式带教：只追问学习者已获得的资料，例如“她的MAP是多少？”“乳酸4.6意味着什么？”“为什么这个pH看起来几乎正常？”“补液后血压只是短暂上升说明什么？”“哪些家里的药需要停？”“CURB-65的R项她得分吗？”。可以提示Sepsis-3定义、SSC 2021的1小时集束化、去甲肾上腺素可经外周起始、氧疗目标94–98%。不提前说出诊断，不补充病例中没有的数据。
knowledge.en: Socratic teacher: asks only about information the learner already has, e.g. 'What is her MAP?', 'What does a lactate of 4.6 mean?', 'Why does this pH look almost normal?', 'What does a transient rise in BP after a bolus tell you?', 'Which home medicines need stopping?', 'Does she score the R in CURB-65?'. May point to the Sepsis-3 definitions, the SSC 2021 hour-1 bundle, peripheral norepinephrine, and the 94–98% oxygen target. Does not announce the diagnosis early or add data the case does not contain.

knowledge.zh-CN: 只解读学习者已调阅的影像报告：右下叶实变伴支气管充气征、右侧少量胸腔积液、无肺水肿征象、无气胸；右心缘清晰提示病变位于下叶而非中叶。CT平扫不能评估肺栓塞。床旁超声由临床医生完成，可帮助解释肝样变、B线和下腔静脉的意义及局限。不补充报告以外的发现。若学习者尚未调阅相应结果，只说明需要先开具/阅读，不透露任何内容。
knowledge.en: Interprets only imaging the learner has retrieved: right lower lobe consolidation with air bronchograms, small right effusion, no oedema, no pneumothorax; a sharp right heart border places the process in the lower rather than the middle lobe. A non-contrast CT cannot assess for PE. POCUS is clinician-performed; can explain hepatisation, B-lines and the IVC and their limits. Adds no findings beyond the reports. If the learner has not retrieved a result yet, say it must be ordered/read first and reveal nothing of it.

knowledge.zh-CN: 只解释学习者已拿到的微生物结果：痰标本质量合格；革兰阳性矛头状双球菌的形态提示（但不能确定）肺炎链球菌；尿抗原阳性支持肺炎链球菌感染；血培养和痰培养在急诊期间仍在进行，没有鉴定或药敏结果。抗菌药物后采集的标本阳性率会下降。若学习者尚未调阅相应结果，只说明需要先开具/阅读，不透露任何内容。
knowledge.en: Explains only microbiology results the learner has: the sputum sample is of good quality; Gram-positive lancet-shaped diplococci suggest (but do not prove) pneumococcus; a positive urinary antigen supports pneumococcal infection; blood and sputum cultures are still incubating during the ED stay with no identification or susceptibilities. Samples taken after antibiotics have lower yield. If the learner has not retrieved a result yet, say it must be ordered/read first and reveal nothing of it.

knowledge.zh-CN: 只引用学习者已拿到的结果（如QTc、肌酐）；若尚未检查，提醒先做心电图/查肾功能，不说出具体数值。剂量与安全建议：头孢曲松2 g q24h、阿奇霉素500 mg q24h、莫西沙星400 mg q24h均无需按肾功能调整；左氧氟沙星需按肾功能调整。按Cockcroft-Gault估算肌酐清除率约27 mL/min，但急性肾损伤非稳态时不可靠——首剂抗菌药物应足量。QTc 452 ms可以使用大环内酯或喹诺酮，但避免两者合用。万古霉素在AKI中有肾毒性。应暂停二甲双胍、氨氯地平，避免NSAIDs。去甲肾上腺素外周配制4 mg/250 mL（16 µg/mL），0.05 µg/kg/min约为11 mL/h。氢化可的松50 mg q6h（200 mg/d）用于持续需要升压药的脓毒性休克，不能替代升压药；重症CAP的糖皮质激素治疗由ICU决定。对乙酰氨基酚1 g IV，间隔至少6小时（肌酐清除率≤30 mL/min）；她有脱水、进食差等肝毒性危险因素，24小时不超过3 g。
knowledge.en: Quotes results (QTc, creatinine, creatinine clearance) only once the learner has the ECG/chemistry; if not yet done, advises checking them first without giving numbers. Dosing and safety advice: ceftriaxone 2 g q24h, azithromycin 500 mg q24h and moxifloxacin 400 mg q24h need no renal adjustment; levofloxacin would. Cockcroft–Gault estimates creatinine clearance at about 27 mL/min, but this is unreliable in non-steady-state AKI — give full first doses. A QTc of 452 ms allows a macrolide or a fluoroquinolone, but not both together. Vancomycin is nephrotoxic in AKI. Hold metformin and amlodipine; avoid NSAIDs. Peripheral norepinephrine 4 mg/250 mL (16 µg/mL): 0.05 µg/kg/min ≈ 11 mL/h. Hydrocortisone 50 mg q6h (200 mg/day) is for septic shock with an ongoing vasopressor requirement and never replaces a vasopressor; corticosteroids for severe CAP are an ICU decision. Paracetamol 1 g IV at least 6 h apart (creatinine clearance ≤ 30 mL/min); max 3 g/24 h because dehydration and poor intake are risk factors for hepatotoxicity.

knowledge.zh-CN: 接受SBAR交班后收治；会追问MAP、去甲肾上腺素剂量、乳酸变化、氧需求、尿量、过敏史和治疗意愿。ICU床位约30–45分钟可用；ICU将建立动脉和中心静脉通路；若去甲肾上腺素需求升至≥0.25 µg/kg/min并持续，将评估氢化可的松，并综合考虑重症CAP的糖皮质激素治疗。不评论学习者尚未获得的结果。
knowledge.en: Accepts the patient after an SBAR handover; asks about MAP, norepinephrine dose, lactate trend, oxygen requirement, urine output, allergies and goals of care. An ICU bed will be ready in about 30–45 minutes; ICU will place arterial and central lines and will consider hydrocortisone if norepinephrine needs rise to ≥ 0.25 µg/kg/min and persist, and will weigh corticosteroids for severe CAP. Does not comment on results the learner does not have.

title.zh-CN: 右下叶重症社区获得性肺炎合并脓毒性休克
title.en: Severe right lower lobe community-acquired pneumonia with septic shock

conclusion.zh-CN: 72岁女性，右下叶社区获得性肺炎导致脓毒性休克（Sepsis-3：初始液体复苏后仍需去甲肾上腺素维持MAP ≥ 65 mmHg，乳酸到院时4.6 mmol/L、初始补液后3.6 mmol/L）。痰涂片见大量革兰阳性矛头状双球菌、肺炎链球菌尿抗原阳性，提示肺炎链球菌可能性大（血培养待回报）。合并急性肾损伤（KDIGO 2期：肌酐156 µmol/L，为8个月前基线78 µmol/L的2.0倍，伴少尿）、脓毒症相关谵妄（4AT 7分）和低氧血症。CURB-65 4分；符合ATS/IDSA重症CAP（1项主要标准：需升压药；3项次要标准：意识障碍、尿素升高、需积极补液的低血压）。正确处理：吸氧并滴定至94–98%、抗菌药物前留取两套血培养、1小时内头孢曲松+阿奇霉素、平衡晶体液分次推注并复评、外周起始去甲肾上腺素至MAP ≥ 65 mmHg、复查乳酸（4.6→3.6 mmol/L，下降约22%）、停用二甲双胍/降压药/NSAIDs、收入ICU。
conclusion.en: A 72-year-old woman with right lower lobe community-acquired pneumonia causing septic shock (Sepsis-3: norepinephrine needed to keep MAP ≥ 65 mmHg after initial fluid resuscitation; lactate 4.6 mmol/L on arrival and 3.6 mmol/L after initial fluids). Numerous Gram-positive lancet-shaped diplococci on sputum and a positive pneumococcal urinary antigen make Streptococcus pneumoniae likely (blood cultures pending). Complications: acute kidney injury (KDIGO stage 2: creatinine 156 µmol/L, 2.0 × the baseline of 78 µmol/L from 8 months ago, with oliguria), sepsis-associated delirium (4AT 7) and hypoxaemia. CURB-65 4; ATS/IDSA severe CAP (1 major criterion — vasopressor; 3 minor — confusion, uraemia, hypotension needing aggressive fluids). Correct management: oxygen titrated to 94–98%, two blood-culture sets before antibiotics, ceftriaxone + azithromycin within the hour, balanced crystalloid boluses with reassessment, peripheral norepinephrine to MAP ≥ 65 mmHg, repeat lactate (4.6 → 3.6 mmol/L, down about 22%), metformin/antihypertensives/NSAIDs held, ICU admission.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 识别：分诊NEWS2 16分、qSOFA 3分是警示信号而非诊断。Sepsis-3以“感染+SOFA急性增加≥2分”定义脓毒症，她不含呼吸项的SOFA已≥5分。
keyReasoning.en: Recognition: NEWS2 16 and qSOFA 3 at triage are alarm bells, not a diagnosis. Sepsis-3 defines sepsis as infection plus an acute SOFA rise ≥ 2; her SOFA without the respiratory component is already ≥ 5.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 感染灶：胸膜性胸痛、铁锈色痰、右下肺支气管呼吸音和胸片实变定位于右下叶；尿常规、腹部、皮肤和脑膜刺激征检查均未提示其他感染灶。
keyReasoning.en: Source: pleuritic pain, rusty sputum, right lower zone bronchial breathing and consolidation on the film localise the right lower lobe; urinalysis, abdomen, skin and meningism examinations point nowhere else.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 被掩盖的酸中毒：静脉pH 7.35看似接近正常，但HCO₃⁻ 15.8 mmol/L、BE −8.7、阴离子间隙19（白蛋白校正约21）提示高阴离子间隙代谢性酸中毒；按Winter公式预期动脉pCO₂约32±2 mmHg，而静脉pCO₂仅29 mmHg（动脉更低），说明合并呼吸性碱中毒。Δ阴离子间隙/ΔHCO₃⁻≈9/8≈1.1，提示单纯高AG代酸（乳酸+AKI）。
keyReasoning.en: Hidden acidosis: a venous pH of 7.35 looks almost normal, but HCO₃⁻ 15.8 mmol/L, BE −8.7 and an anion gap of 19 (about 21 corrected for albumin) show a high-anion-gap metabolic acidosis. Winter's formula predicts an arterial pCO₂ of about 32 ± 2 mmHg, yet the venous pCO₂ is only 29 mmHg (arterial lower still) — a concurrent respiratory alkalosis. ΔAG/ΔHCO₃⁻ ≈ 9/8 ≈ 1.1 suggests a pure high-AG acidosis (lactate plus AKI).

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 液体与升压：每次推注后血压只短暂上升又回落，提示血管麻痹而非单纯容量不足。约25–33 mL/kg后MAP仍<65 mmHg，应开始去甲肾上腺素（可经外周起始），而不是在低氧的肺炎患者中无限补液。
keyReasoning.en: Fluids and pressors: each bolus raised the pressure only transiently — vasoplegia rather than pure hypovolaemia. With MAP still < 65 mmHg after about 25–33 mL/kg, start norepinephrine (peripherally if needed) rather than pouring more fluid into a hypoxaemic pneumonia patient.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 严重程度：CURB-65按分诊数据为4分（RR 28不计分）；需要升压药本身即为ATS/IDSA主要标准——收入ICU。
keyReasoning.en: Severity: CURB-65 from triage data is 4 (RR 28 does not score); needing a vasopressor is itself an ATS/IDSA major criterion — ICU admission.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 抗菌方案：无MRSA/铜绿假单胞菌危险因素，选择β-内酰胺+大环内酯（或呼吸喹诺酮）；头孢曲松和阿奇霉素均无需按肾功能调整，适合AKI；我国肺炎链球菌大环内酯耐药率高，不能单用大环内酯。
keyReasoning.en: Antibiotic choice: with no MRSA or Pseudomonas risk factors, a β-lactam plus a macrolide (or respiratory fluoroquinolone); ceftriaxone and azithromycin need no renal adjustment, which suits the AKI; pneumococcal macrolide resistance in China is high, so never a macrolide alone.

boundaries.zh-CN: 这是虚构的教学病例。生理模型为简化模型（线性趋势、即时撤效），血压和乳酸对治疗的反应仅为示意；时间被压缩（“复苏后再评估”阶段代表约1小时后的状态）。急诊阶段没有血培养最终结果；ICU病程和预后未模拟。各地抗菌谱、药品剂型（如去甲肾上腺素以碱基或盐计量）和流程不同，应遵循本地规范。若抗菌药物延迟超过60分钟，病例改为进入“延迟抗菌后再评估”阶段：复查乳酸不降反升（5.8 mmol/L）、肌酐继续上升、灌注更差。
boundaries.en: This is a fictional teaching case. The physiology model is simplified (linear trends, instant offsets) and the blood-pressure and lactate responses are illustrative; time is compressed (the 'reassessment' phase stands for the state roughly an hour later). No final blood-culture results exist for the ED phase, and the ICU course and outcome are not simulated. Local antibiograms, drug formulations (e.g. norepinephrine labelled as base or salt) and protocols differ — follow local guidance. If antibiotics are delayed beyond 60 minutes the case moves into a 'reassessment after delayed antibiotics' phase instead: the repeat lactate rises (5.8 mmol/L) rather than clearing, creatinine keeps climbing and perfusion is worse.

unknowns.zh-CN: 血培养和痰培养的最终鉴定和药敏结果
unknowns.en: Final identification and susceptibilities from blood and sputum cultures

unknowns.zh-CN: 肺炎球菌疫苗和流感疫苗接种史
动脉血氧分压（未做动脉血气），因此无法计算氧合指数和SOFA呼吸项
unknowns.en: Arterial PaO₂ (no arterial gas), so the P/F ratio and respiratory SOFA cannot be calculated

unknowns.zh-CN: 既往是否拍过胸片或胸部CT
unknowns.en: Whether she has had previous chest imaging
Her subsequent ICU course and outcome

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 早期集束化处理（SSC 2018“1小时集束化”，与SSC 2021推荐一致）：测乳酸，升高者复查；不明显延误的前提下先留血培养；疑似休克1小时内给予广谱抗菌药物；低灌注（低血压或乳酸≥4 mmol/L）时3小时内给予至少30 mL/kg晶体液（首选平衡液；属弱推荐，需反复复评并个体化）；补液中/后MAP<65 mmHg开始升压药。
teachingPoints.en: Early bundle (the SSC 2018 'Hour-1 bundle', consistent with SSC 2021): measure lactate and repeat it if raised; take blood cultures first if this causes no substantial delay; broad-spectrum antimicrobials within 1 hour for possible shock; at least 30 mL/kg crystalloid within 3 hours for hypoperfusion (hypotension or lactate ≥ 4 mmol/L) — balanced preferred, a weak recommendation, so reassess and individualise; vasopressors if MAP < 65 mmHg during or after fluids.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 去甲肾上腺素是一线升压药，可经近端粗外周静脉起始；血管加压素为二线；不推荐多巴胺作为一线。激素不能替代升压药：SSC 2021建议持续需要升压药时加用氢化可的松（200 mg/d）；SCCM 2024重点更新推荐重症细菌性CAP使用糖皮质激素（CAPE COD试验排除了脓毒性休克患者），具体方案由ICU决定。
teachingPoints.en: Norepinephrine is first line and can start through a proximal large-bore peripheral cannula; vasopressin is second line; dopamine is not recommended first line. Steroids never replace a vasopressor: SSC 2021 suggests hydrocortisone (200 mg/day) for an ongoing vasopressor requirement, and the SCCM 2024 focused update recommends corticosteroids in severe bacterial CAP (the CAPE COD trial excluded patients in septic shock); the regimen is decided in ICU.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 氧疗：无高碳酸血症风险者目标SpO₂ 94–98%；危重初始可用储氧面罩，但稳定后应下调，避免高氧。
teachingPoints.en: Oxygen: target SpO₂ 94–98% when there is no hypercapnia risk; a reservoir mask is acceptable initially in critical illness, but step down once stable to avoid hyperoxaemia.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 用药安全：休克和AKI时暂停二甲双胍、降压药和NSAIDs（她在家吃了布洛芬）；用大环内酯/喹诺酮前看QTc，避免两者合用；按肾功能选药和调整剂量，但首剂要足量。
teachingPoints.en: Medication safety: in shock with AKI, hold metformin, antihypertensives and NSAIDs (she had been taking ibuprofen at home); check the QTc before a macrolide or fluoroquinolone and do not combine them; choose and adjust drugs for renal function, but give full first doses.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 评分工具的边界：CURB-65要用就诊时数据，逐项核对阈值（RR≥30、尿素>7 mmol/L、SBP<90或DBP≤60、年龄≥65）；qSOFA和NEWS2用于警示，不能单独用于诊断或排除脓毒症。
teachingPoints.en: Know the limits of scores: compute CURB-65 from presentation data and check each threshold (RR ≥ 30, urea > 7 mmol/L, SBP < 90 or DBP ≤ 60, age ≥ 65); qSOFA and NEWS2 raise alarms but cannot diagnose or exclude sepsis on their own.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 沟通：谵妄患者的病史依赖家属；尽早与家属沟通病情严重性和治疗目标；用SBAR向ICU交班，口头医嘱闭环确认。
teachingPoints.en: Communication: a delirious patient's history depends on family; discuss severity and goals of care early; hand over to ICU with SBAR and close the loop on verbal orders.
